games.thesis: Katie Boulter's superior Elo rating and recent dominant form against lower-ranked opponents outweigh Antonia Ruzic's current momentum in this best-of-three quarterfinal.
Daniil Medvedev is heavily favored based on Elo ratings, head-to-head record, and recent form.
Iva Jovic has a slight Elo and head-to-head edge, and her recent performance suggests she is in good form.
Elena Rybakina has a much stronger Elo rating and recent form, making her the clear favorite.
Cerundolo has a higher Elo rating and less recent workload, giving him a stronger chance to win.
Tommy Paul's higher Elo and ranking suggest a stronger chance of winning, but Moutet's recent match experience could provide a slight edge.
Altmaier's recent form and lower workload may give him a chance to upset Fritz.
Tallon Griekspoor has a strong head-to-head record and more recent match experience, giving him a slight edge.
Bublik's lower workload and higher Elo rating make him the more likely winner.
Arthur Fils has a higher Elo and less recent workload, giving him a stronger edge.
Cobolli's recent performance and lower workload suggest he is more likely to win.
Zizou Bergs has a higher Elo rating and is fresher, giving him a stronger chance to win.
Borussia Mönchengladbach is more likely to win due to their recent performance and potential for a strong comeback.
Lorenzo Musetti has a higher Elo rating and more recent match experience, giving him the edge.
Monza's strong attacking record and pregame odds suggest a higher chance of winning.
Nice has better recent form and key players contributing, making them more likely to win.
Ipswich Town has better recent form and home advantage, making them more likely to win.
Alavés has stronger recent form and key players with higher goal contributions, giving them a higher chance to win.
Bolton's recent win and momentum may help them overcome Middlesbrough's poor form.
Milwaukee Bucks are more likely to win due to fewer injuries and better team stats model prediction.
No evidence to favor either fighter; outcome is uncertain.
Duke's strong rushing and passing performances give them an edge in this matchup.
UConn Huskies are more likely to win due to their bye week advantage and home-field advantage.
Boston Celtics have a stronger team model and key players in form, giving them the edge.
Atlanta Hawks have fewer key injuries and a stronger recent performance, making them more likely to win.
Dallas Mavericks are unlikely to win due to key injuries and poor recent form, while Indiana Pacers have a strong home-court advantage.
Minnesota has fewer key injuries and stronger overall team form, giving them a higher chance to win.
Toronto has no major injuries and is the pregame favorite, giving them a strong edge.
Detroit has the advantage due to rest and a stronger recent form, despite a minor injury impact.
Milwaukee has a stronger starter and Tampa Bay is missing a key pitcher, giving them an edge.
Chicago benefits from Montreal's key injury and stronger home performance, increasing their chances.
Army's dominant rushing attack and strong performance on the ground make them the most likely winner.
Air Force's stronger rushing attack and favorable weather conditions (which hurt passing) make them more likely to win.
Tampa Bay Lightning's strong record, elite goaltending, and fewer injuries make them the more likely winner.
Houston Rockets are more likely to win due to fewer key injuries and strong early season form, despite San Antonio's rest advantage.
Utah's key injuries significantly weaken their chances, giving New Orleans a better shot despite being the underdog.
Golden State's injuries are more severe, but Memphis' injuries are also impactful, making the game very close.
The LA Clippers have significant injury issues, while the Lakers' injury impact is minimal and their model shows strong favorability.
Portland Trail Blazers are more likely to win due to their strong start and Sacramento's injury issues.
NC State benefits from a bye week and has a strong passing game, giving them a slight edge.
Ann Li has a higher Elo rating and more match experience in the tournament, giving her a slight edge.
